name: Canonical message mapping
evidence: Map_PurchaseOrder_To_CanonicalOrder transforms PurchaseOrder to CanonicalOrder before business logic.

name: Content-based routing
evidence: Decide_ApprovalRequired sends OrderTotal >= 5000 to approval and all other orders to fulfilment.

name: Scoped exception handling
evidence: Catch_OrderFailure catches System.Exception, constructs OrderError, and sends it to a dedicated error port.

name: Transport retry
evidence: All three FILE send ports specify RetryCount 3 and RetryInterval 5; ordered delivery and stop-on-failure are false.
